items.title: Zeke Mullins interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 9, 2017
items.q: [(boilerplate)] Zeke was interviewed in New Hartford, New York on June 9, 2017, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

ctx.x: Zeke was interviewed in New Hartford, New York on June 9, 2017, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are near Clinton, NY. I’m pleased to be talking with pianist Zeke Mullins today. Welcome.
